fields.claim: No impact, puncture or through-thickness ductility data exist for thin SR-200 sheet. NASA 1971 calls beryllium's impact resistance extremely low. A cracked outer face vents its core cells; whether the CR-III core is perforated (034's evacuation of every cell) decides whether a crack vents the whole core.
fields.needed_to_ground: Drop and ice-ball tests on 0.8 mm SR-200 sheet over honeycomb, and the core venting design.
